premise: Acorn wants to be as tall as the big oaks at once; after the rain Duckling plants her in the soft mud by the pond, and the first thing she grows is a root, down, before a shoot comes up.
inspiration: Jack and the Beanstalk, turned slow and true: no magic and no giant, just a root going down before a shoot goes up.
lesson: Growing takes time, and it starts where nobody can see.
learning: An acorn grows a root down first, then a shoot up

en-US.title: Acorn Grows Down First
en-US.text: {acorn:enter} {acorn:pulse} Little Acorn looked up at the big oaks at the edge of the meadow. {acorn:face happy} [excited] I want to be THAT tall! she said. {pinecone:enter} Pinecone {pinecone:wobble} rolled over. You need soft ground, she said. And a drink. {canvas:rain 0.6 12s} {sfx:rain-bed} Pitter-patter, the rain came down, and the ground by the pond went squishy and soft. {duckling:enter} Duckling {duckling:hop x2} loved it. {duckling:face happy} Quack! Just right for planting! He dug a little hole with his beak, and in went Acorn, {acorn:face sleeping} snug as a nest. [whispers] Then they waited. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 12s} The sun came out. [curious] Was she growing up? {acorn:face surprised} Not yet! First a tiny root wriggled DOWN into the mud, to hold on tight. {acorn:shake} Wriggle, wriggle. And then… {acorn:glow} {sfx:sprout} a little green shoot poked up. {all:face happy} {pinecone:hop} {duckling:hop} Hooray! [softly] And one day, a long, long time from now, she will be as tall as the oaks. {acorn:hearts}

es-ES.title: Bellota crece hacia abajo
es-ES.text: {acorn:enter} {acorn:pulse} La pequeña Bellota miró los grandes robles al borde del prado. {acorn:face happy} [excited] ¡Yo quiero ser así de ALTA!, dijo. {pinecone:enter} Piña {pinecone:wobble} llegó rodando. Necesitas tierra blandita, le dijo. Y agua. {canvas:rain 0.6 12s} {sfx:rain-bed} Plic, ploc, empezó a llover, y la tierra junto a la charca se puso blandita y embarrada. A {duckling:enter} Patito {duckling:hop x2} le encantó. {duckling:face happy} ¡Cuac! ¡Perfecta para plantar! Hizo un hoyito con el pico, y allá que entró Bellota, {acorn:face sleeping} calentita como en un nido. [whispers] Y esperaron. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 12s} Salió el sol. [curious] ¿Estaba creciendo hacia arriba? {acorn:face surprised} ¡Todavía no! Primero, una raicita diminuta bajó hacia el barro, ABAJO, para agarrarse bien. {acorn:shake} Culebrea que culebrea. Y entonces… {acorn:glow} {sfx:sprout} asomó un tallito verde. {all:face happy} {pinecone:hop} {duckling:hop} ¡Bien! [softly] Y algún día, dentro de mucho, mucho tiempo, será tan alta como los robles. {acorn:hearts}

rain-bed.prompt: light gentle rain pattering on grass and a still pond

sprout.prompt: a tiny soft pop of a seedling breaking through damp soil
